scriptOverride.reason: mode: 'select' choices are each a full nested card selection (their own controller/cardCondition/gameAction, and the second choice even switches which player makes the pick), not a plain predicate or gameAction leaf value - the schema's target.choices only supports the latter (see city-of-the-open-hand). A two-level 'choose which action, then choose a card for it' selection has no generic representation yet, consistent with the bespoke multi-step prompt handlers on duelist-training/shiba-tsukune.
